description: We are six students of 8th grade of Instituto Cervino, Guaymas Sonora.
summary: Our project, Abandoned But Not Forgotten, is about NASA’s equipment left on the Moon, Mars, and in space. We developed an interactive trivia game using Genially to teach students about these machines, their missions, and the discoveries they helped make. Our project addresses the challenge by sharing the history and importance of NASA’s equipment in a fun and interesting way, instead of just showing pictures. We believe this project is important because it helps younger generations learn more about space exploration and understand that even if some machines stop working, their discoveries are never forgotten.
details: It works by answering a trivia game. It has the benefit of showing people about our team and more about NASA. It‘s tended to have fun and be interactive. We used Genially and docs. It’s creative because is fun and interesting. We considered fun and entertainment.
